_comment: USER cast order (2026-11-04, MTG_SB_CAST_ORDER): 'So it should be Dark Ritual, <shadowborn sacrifice for culling
if needed>, Culling, Thrumming stone...' -- 'If needed here is pretty much just so that you can cast culling when
no shadowborn is out.' An EMPTY board, two Swamps: Ritual {B} -> BBB (4 total), an Apostle {B} as Culling's
